messages: For the currently selected UTC day, compare the MODIS and VIIRS detection counts. State the exact date and explain why the sensor counts differ. Cite the stored records.

AI-assisted interpretationMODIS vs VIIRS detections on the selected UTC day (Park Fire replay)On the selected UTC day in the Park Fire replay, the stored frame shows a large MODIS standard-product detection count while VIIRS S-NPP reports none. The difference is not evidence of sensor disagreement: NASA documented a Suomi-NPP standard-product processing gap spanning this day, so the VIIRS frame is labeled a documented product gap despite complete export requests. Zero is a gap-day absence of eligible records, not proof of no fire.
